features: WIRELESS BLUETOOTH RECEIVER: Transmits audio signals wirelessly via Bluetooth, letting you enjoy music anytime and anywhere without messy cables.

description: Transform any wired speaker or car stereo into a wireless audio system with this compact USB Bluetooth Music Receiver. Simply plug the device into any USB power source — whether it's your car's USB port or a wall adapter — and connect it to your speaker or car stereo via the included 3.5mm audio cable. Once paired with your smartphone, tablet, or any Bluetooth-enabled device, you can stream your favourite music wirelessly from up to 10 metres away. The setup is effortless and requires no complicated installation. It is ideal for use in cars, homes, or offices, making it a versatile audio upgrade for any setting. The compact, dongle-style design ensures it stays discreet and out of the way. Whether you are on a long drive or relaxing at home, this Bluetooth receiver lets you enjoy high-quality wireless audio anytime and anywhere. Compatible with a wide range of Bluetooth devices, it is a simple yet effective solution to cut the clutter of cables and enjoy seamless, wire-free music streaming.
